standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 2282-2283)
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the descending quasi-compact neighbourhoods closed.

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that an intersection of nonempty closed subsets of a quasi-compact space is nonempty
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 2284-2286)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a point in the total intersection.

core_obligations: Normalize the sequence: replacing each open subset by the intersection of the first n makes the sequence descending, so it suffices to show that any point is in the closure of the intersection (proof lines 2267-2273)
Localize: replace a neighbourhood of the point by a smaller quasi-compact one, which is possible because the space is locally quasi-compact (proof lines 2273-2276)

Inductive construction: choose points and quasi-compact neighbourhoods nested inside the previous ones and inside the successive dense opens; the neighbourhoods are closed by Hausdorffness, so their total intersection is nonempty and lies inside the required intersection (proof lines 2277-2298)
proof_roadmap: 把 U_n 换成 U_1 ∩ … ∩ U_n ⇒ 不妨设 U_1 ⊃ U_2 ⊃ …。
取 x 与邻域 E，缩成准紧邻域；令 x_0 = x, E_0 = E，归纳取 x_i ∈ E_{i-1} ∩ U_i 与准紧邻域 E_i ⊂ E_{i-1} ∩ U_i。
E_i 在 Hausdorff 空间中闭且非空 ⇒ ∩E_i 非空（准紧中闭集族的有限交判据）且含于 E ∩ ∩U_n。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the Baire category theorem for locally quasi-compact Hausdorff spaces: a countable intersection of dense open subsets is dense (author lemma at source lines 2260-2265, label lemma-baire-category-locally-compact). The proof (source lines 2267-2299) normalizes the sequence to a descending one, localizes a neighbourhood to a quasi-compact one and runs an inductive construction of nested nonempty quasi-compact neighbourhoods, whose total intersection is nonempty because they are closed in a Hausdorff space (proof lines 2267-2298). The inductive construction and the intersection step are the substance. H3.
